Question: What does 'FUP applied' mean on my data usage?

Answer: Fair Usage Policy (FUP) applies once you exceed the high-speed data limit included in your plan; speeds are then typically reduced (e.g., to 64/128/512 kbps) for the remainder of the billing cycle rather than data being stopped entirely.

Topic: Data Services & Speed
title: What does 'FUP applied' mean on my data usage?
